_comment: Fidelity-gate registry. Every headline number in README.md / SUBMISSION.md is bound here to a field in a committed benchmark artifact. scripts/check_claims.py fails CI if data (benchmark/*.json), registry (this file), and prose (the docs) ever diverge. Re-baseline after an intentional benchmark change with: python scripts/check_claims.py --update  (then reconcile the prose). Inspired by the NCypher finalist's CI reproducibility gate — see vault Hackathons/.../Finalist-NCypher.md.

claims.statement: A frontier model strictly identifies only ~18% of documented-identity contaminated lines (n=530).
The model is confidently wrong on 230 of the 594 register lines.

The model false-flags 0 of the 36 independent authentic control lines.
The tool catches 92% end-to-end on messy Methods prose.
37 of 40 contaminated lines caught end-to-end (the 92% numerator).
